title: 第四百零五章 变量第四百零四章 死核
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工
content_zh:
第四百零五章变量
菲尔德在适应死核的节奏。
第一颗死核让菲尔德的心脏停了半秒，他用了将近一分钟才完全恢复。
三颗叠加让菲尔德失衡了三秒，但他只用了不到十秒就重新找回了出手的力量。
菲尔德的身体在自我调整，对抗死亡能量对生理节律的干扰。
“居然能做到这种程度吗？”基拉苍白的瞳孔中出现了惊讶的情绪，他原以为自己对菲尔德足够了解...但现在看来，他们两人都一直在藏东西！
“【肉体增幅】的本质不只是增加力量。”
菲尔德活动着手腕，“是对身体每一块肌肉、每一条神经、每一次心跳的完全掌控。
【死核】干扰的是生命的节律。
但对我来说，自己的心跳也是可以被训练的。
在被干扰一次之后，我的身体会自动调整心脏起搏的频率来对冲外部干扰。
我能够控制自己的心跳。”
他说着迈出了脚步。
基拉同时挥镰，镰刀沿着对角线斜劈下来，菲尔德侧身闪避，镰刀砍进他脚边的石砖，石屑溅到他的小腿上。
他没有后退，反而向前又迈了一步。
基拉将镰刀从石砖中拔出来，横斩追击，菲尔德低头从镰柄下方钻过去，军刀反手撩向基拉腋下。
基拉用左手的骨爪挡住了军刀，刀尖在骨爪的鳞甲上划出一道浅痕。
两个人的距离已经近到了能让基拉的左手骨爪够到菲尔德的地步，他的左手五指握拢成锥，骨爪朝菲尔德的头顶砸下来。
菲尔德侧头躲开，骨爪砸在他肩膀旁边的石板上，石板碎成一个手掌形的坑。
两个人就这样在不到一臂的距离内开始了近身换招。

基拉的镰刀在这个距离内发挥不了最大威力，但骨翼和左手的骨爪弥补了一部分缺陷。
菲尔德也占不到绝对的便宜，他的力量在近身范围内可以发挥到极致，但基拉的鳞甲太厚，而且那些鳞甲不是静止的。
它们会在他出刀之前微微颤动，然后在他攻击的同一时间向攻击方向滑动半寸，让原本应该砍在鳞甲缝隙上的刀锋偏移到鳞甲最厚的部位。
基拉开始回避菲尔德的正面攻击。
他的打法从之前那种主动进攻变成了以闪避和格挡为主的被动防御，同时不断地在防御间隙中凝结【死核】干扰菲尔德的节奏。
死核的释放频率比之前低了很多，他不再试图用叠加的死核来一次性重创菲尔德，而是将死核分散在不同的时间点释放。
这是基拉战术的第二层。
第一层是【死核】的叠加干扰，靠累积效应来削弱对手。
第二层是节奏破坏。
基拉用死核精准地打断菲尔德的攻击节奏，让他的连续攻击始终无法形成完整的压制链条。
每一次菲尔德即将把优势转化为胜势的关键时刻，心跳或呼吸就会被打断一次，然后优势就从指缝中滑走了。
尽管对方可以在很短的时间内调整回来，但那一瞬间的凝滞会让基拉寻找到真正的破绽。
菲尔德在第四次被【死核】打断连招之后往后退了两步，拉开了距离。
他的呼吸粗重，汗水混着伤口渗出的血沿着脊背往下淌。
基拉站在他对面的不远处，状态看起来同样不怎么好。
右膝外侧的鳞甲已经碎了一大片，露出下面灰白色的软组织。
右肋那道最早被菲尔德砍中的伤口经过反复的冲击，新生的鳞甲再次裂开，裂口比第一次更大更深。
这是一场拉锯战。
菲尔德和基拉的实力本就在伯仲之间。
之前几次战斗也都是在久久不能分出胜负的情况下潦草收场。

但这次不同。
第四百零五章变量
基拉认为自己占尽了主场优势，科尔温城的居民会为他源源不断的提供【死亡能量】......他认为自己可以拖死菲尔德。
content_en:
Chapter 405 Variables
Field is adapting to the rhythm of deathcore.
The first death core stopped Field's heart for half a second, and it took him nearly a minute to fully recover.
The three superpositions knocked Field off balance for three seconds, but it took him less than ten seconds to regain the power to shoot.
Field's body adjusted itself against the interference of death energy with its circadian rhythms.
"Can you actually do it to this extent?" Kira's pale pupils showed surprise. He thought he knew Field well enough... But now it seems that both of them have been hiding things!
"The essence of [Physical Amplification] is not just to increase strength."
Field moves his wrist, “with complete control over every muscle, every nerve, every heartbeat in his body.
[Deathcore] interferes with the rhythm of life.
But for me, my own heartbeat can also be trained.
After being disturbed once, my body will automatically adjust the heart pacing frequency to hedge against external interference.
I can control my heartbeat. "
He said taking a step forward.
Kira swung the sickle at the same time, and the sickle slashed down diagonally. Field dodged sideways, and the sickle cut into the stone bricks at his feet, and stone chips splashed on his calf.
He didn't step back, but took another step forward.
Kira pulled the sickle out of the stone bricks and pursued him with a horizontal slash. Field lowered his head and ducked under the handle of the sickle, and raised the saber under Kira's arm with his backhand.
Kira blocked the saber with the bone claw of her left hand, and the tip of the knife drew a shallow mark on the scales of the bone claw.
The distance between the two people was close enough for Kira's left bone claw to reach Field. The five fingers of his left hand were clenched into a cone, and the bone claw smashed down on Field's head.
Field turned his head to avoid it, and the bone claws hit the stone slab next to his shoulder, which shattered into a palm-shaped pit.
The two people started exchanging moves at close range within an arm's length.
Kira's scythe cannot exert its maximum power at this distance, but the bone wings and the bone claws on his left hand make up for part of the shortcomings.
Field doesn't have an absolute advantage. His power can be used to the extreme in close range, but Kira's scales are too thick, and those scales are not static.
They will tremble slightly before he draws the sword, and then slide half an inch in the direction of attack at the same time as he attacks, causing the blade that should originally strike at the gap in the scales to shift to the thickest part of the scales.
Kira began to avoid Field's frontal attack.
His style of play has changed from the previous active attack to passive defense based on dodge and block. At the same time, he constantly condenses [Dead Core] in the gaps between defenses to interfere with Field's rhythm.
The frequency of the release of the death core is much lower than before. He no longer tries to use the superimposed death core to hit Field hard at one time, but releases the death core at different points in time.
This is the second level of Kira's tactics.
The first layer is the superimposed interference of [Death Core], which relies on the cumulative effect to weaken the opponent.
The second level is rhythm destruction.
Kira used his death core to accurately interrupt Field's attack rhythm, preventing his continuous attacks from forming a complete chain of suppression.
Every time Field was about to turn his advantage into a critical moment, his heartbeat or breathing would be interrupted, and then the advantage would slip through his fingers.
Although the opponent can adjust back in a short period of time, the moment of stagnation will allow Kira to find the real flaw.
After being interrupted by [Death Core] for the fourth time, Field took two steps back and distanced himself.
His breathing was heavy, and sweat mixed with blood from the wound flowed down his back.
Kira stood not far away opposite him, and his condition also looked not very good.
A large piece of the scale on the outside of the right knee has been broken into pieces, exposing the gray-white soft tissue underneath.
The wound on the right rib that was first struck by Field went through repeated impacts, and the new scales cracked again, and the crack was larger than the first time.Deeper.
This is a tug of war.
The strength of Field and Kira was already on par.
The previous few battles also ended in a hurry without being able to tell the winner for a long time.
But this time it's different.
Chapter 405 Variables
Kira thought that he had the home field advantage, and the residents of Corwin City would provide him with a steady stream of [death energy]... He thought that he could drag Field to death.
